notifications.update_failed_body: An error occurred while installing updates.
notifications.updates_available_body: {count} pending updates are ready to install.

check_interval.description: How often to automatically check for updates in minutes (0 to disable).
check_interval.label: Check Interval (Minutes)

enable_dnf.description: Check for and manage DNF5 system package updates.
enable_dnf.label: Enable DNF

enable_flatpak.description: Check for and manage Flatpak application updates.
enable_flatpak.label: Enable Flatpak

glyph.description: Icon glyph to display in the Noctalia bar widget.
glyph.label: Widget Icon

include_flatpak_runtimes.description: Include Flatpak runtime and extension updates alongside applications.
include_flatpak_runtimes.label: Include Flatpak Runtimes

notify_on_updates.description: Send a desktop notification when new pending updates are found.
notify_on_updates.label: Notify on New Updates

show_widget_when_clean.description: Show the bar widget even when there are no pending updates.
show_widget_when_clean.label: Show Widget When Clean

update_in_terminal.description: Launch update commands inside a terminal emulator instead of running in background with polkit.
update_in_terminal.label: Run Updates in Terminal
